Hi Alex — welcome, and thanks for the clear summary and docs.

Short answer: were open to a temporary invoice-only path for short pilots under specific guardrails, but it requires an internal approval and a few items from your side. Our standard procurement policy requires a PO for vendor onboarding except when the engagement meets a small-dollar pilot threshold and the vendor agrees to the conditional terms. To move fast I need the following:

- Completed vendor questionnaire (received) — thank you.
- W-9 or local tax form
- Proof of general liability insurance or note if none
- Signed SOW or email acceptance of terms

If procurement approves a temporary carveout, the conditions are typically:
- Pilot spend capped (well propose $25k cap)
- Net-30 invoice terms and explicit requirement to convert to PO/contract beyond pilot
- Finance holdback clause if spend exceeds cap

Im looping in Marissa from Procurement and Naomi from Finance to start the approval. Marissa — are you able to review the attached and advise on the waiver form/process? Naomi — can you flag any concerns on cashflow/chargeback if this goes over?

Alex, can you confirm when the pilot invoice would be sent and whether MicroEdge can accept Net-30?

Best,

Thanks Vanessa and Alex — I reviewed the SOW and questionnaire. Procurement is okay with a temporary PO-waiver for short pilots under the following conditional approval (this is a standard lightweight path we use for small professional-services pilots):

1) Cap: $25,000 total for the pilot period (explicitly listed on the invoice)
2) Required docs: W-9, Vendor Questionnaire, signed SOW or signed addendum
3) Invoice cadence: single final invoice at pilot completion preferred; interim invoices require pre-approval
4) Waiver term: 60 days maximum; if pilot continues or spend approaches cap we require a formal PO or purchase commitment
5) Risk controls: MicroEdge must acknowledge liability and indemnity sections in our onboarding form; we will not enable sensitive-data integrations until SOC/controls are confirmed

Ive attached the PO-Waiver-Request-Form.pdf — please have the vendor sign and return. Priyom, can Finance sign off on Net-30 and confirm whether chargeback will be acceptable if the cap is exceeded? Naomi, please confirm the GL code to use if approved.

If Alex can return the W-9 and signed waiver form today we can fast-track approval and issue a temporary waiver ID for accounting to accept invoice(s).

Cheers,
